_doc: OGRL-20261010-012. run39 continued on the terrain-style maps (user review 2026-10-10: the t_train maps were too big -- enemies spawned 27 m away on average, up to 63 m -- with the agent waiting for them, scattered boxes no real map has, and one fixed start arrangement per map). Same learner and fight mix as run39 (personas 50%, hidden intent 30%, hop-aware 40%, difficulty 1.0, weight decay); only the maps change: 24 maps t_nat3_701..724 from gen_natural_map.py (tilted hillside floor, uneven sloped rim, terrace with wide ramps, hills, rolling ridges; 6 start arrangements per fight size drawn per round: front, surround, staggered, behind, pincer, scattered). t_nat3_held_801..804 are never trained on. Measured with run38_d1_wd@215M (60 fights): first contact 1.2 s vs 4.0 s on t_train, no timeouts, 32/60 won.
purpose: OGRL-20261010-012 run39_terrain: run39 continued on 24 terrain maps with random start arrangements
